# homelab-images

> Container images for mitchross's homelab. The main image is ghcr.io/mitchross/paseo-dev: Paseo (a browser workspace for coding agents) with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, compilers, and cluster CLIs. Use deploy/kubernetes/paseo to run it on any Kubernetes cluster.

Rules for agents that deploy Paseo:
- Ask the user for hostname, Gateway API or Ingress, StorageClass, and LLM server URL before editing.
- Keep secrets out of Git. Create the PASEO_PASSWORD Secret with kubectl.
- Pin the image by digest. The main tag moves with each build.
- Use Recreate, not RollingUpdate. Both volumes are ReadWriteOnce.
- Write Pi apiKey values as "$NAME". A bare name is sent as a literal key.
- Set PASEO_HOSTNAMES to every DNS name, or requests fail with 403 Host not allowed.
- Set PASEO_TRUSTED_PROXIES behind a TLS proxy, or the web UI cannot auto-connect.
- Never delete the namespace or PVCs: they hold the user's logins and code.

## Guides

- [Run Paseo on your Kubernetes cluster](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mitchross/homelab-images/main/deploy/kubernetes/paseo/README.md): step-by-step deploy with plain manifests
- [paseo-dev image guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mitchross/homelab-images/main/images/paseo-dev/README.md): what is installed, Docker Compose, first connection, one-time logins, Pi, security

- [kustomization.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mitchross/homelab-images/main/deploy/kubernetes/paseo/kustomization.yaml)

## Image internals

- [Dockerfile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mitchross/homelab-images/main/images/paseo-dev/Dockerfile)
- [mise.toml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mitchross/homelab-images/main/images/paseo-dev/mise.toml): language runtimes and CLI versions
- [entrypoint.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mitchross/homelab-images/main/images/paseo-dev/scripts/entrypoint.sh): first-boot Pi seeds, password check
